title: Lockstep simulation of a plain machine
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$. For every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the oracle machine associated to $M$ for $t$ steps from the embedded configuration of $c$, with oracle $O$, gives the embedding of the configuration reached by running $M$ for $t$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
replaced:
Let $M_0$ be a plain multi-tape machine with $k$ work tapes, let $O$ be any
oracle language, let $c$ be a configuration of $M_0$, and let
$t \in \mathbb{N}$.  Running the oracle machine obtained by embedding $M_0$
for $t$ steps relative to $O$ from the embedding of $c$ yields the embedding
of the configuration obtained by running $M_0$ for $t$ steps from $c$.
